reproduction.reader: services/source_ingestion/scheduler.py at 3f65a8b3e (dev head before this task), loaded from git
reproduction.shape: 12 receipts embedding 120 snapshot bodies each (4 older than 30 days), scaled down from the hosted 2.2 GB journal
reproduction.result: first load rewrote the journal 1209588 -> under 20% in place; directory held only the journal and its lock; no .pre-migrate.bak

design.backup: <journal>.pre-migrate.bak by os.link, shared code path services.source_ingestion.scheduler.keep_journal_backup used by the service and scripts/migrate_ingest_receipts.py
design.keep_window: 7 days, setting SOURCE_INGEST_RECEIPT_BACKUP_KEEP_DAYS (default 7, minimum 1); creation time is stamped in the backup mtime before the link so expiry is never early
design.existing_backup: an unexpired backup is never replaced; at most one backup file
design.health: journal_stats().rewrite_backup {path, bytes, keep_days, created_at, expires_at}; last_slim_rewrite.plan {receipts_to_compact, receipts_to_drop_by_retention, bytes_before, bytes_after}; last_slim_rewrite.skipped_reason; the plan is also logged at INFO before the journal is replaced

disk_bound.extra_bytes_held_by_backup: at most the journal size before the rewrite (hard link, no copy); hosted shape 2.2 GB journal => at most 2.2 GB extra, 42 MB new file
disk_bound.skip_rule: rewrite skipped with a readable reason when free disk < journal bytes + SOURCE_INGEST_RECEIPT_REWRITE_FREE_MARGIN_BYTES (default 256 MiB); journal left unchanged, replay still compacts in memory

rollback: rename <journal>.pre-migrate.bak over the journal; read by the new store and by the previous reader (scheduler at 3f65a8b3e) in test_rollback_by_rename_is_read_by_new_and_previous_reader; crash between hard link and rename covered by test_crash_between_hard_link_and_rename_leaves_a_complete_journal_and_backup

validation.command: pytest scripts/test_migrate_ingest_receipts.py + refs_bounded + incremental_replay (before new tests)

not_run: the full services/source_ingestion/tests directory exceeded the 10 minute bound in one batch; not claimed as passed
